summary: Seven hour delay leaving Chicago for Cancun
story: Our flight from Chicago to Cancun on July 24 was supposed to leave at 9:15 in the morning. There was a mechanical problem and we finally took off at 4:20 in the afternoon, so I lost most of the first day of my vacation sitting at O'Hare. I bought lunch and a day pass for the airport lounge so I could at least wait somewhere comfortable. I would like to be reimbursed for both. Receipts attached.

items.description: Lunch and snacks at the airport

documents.name: Northwind Airlines delay confirmation
documents.content: Northwind Airlines. Flight NW 1427 Chicago ORD to Cancun CUN, July 24, 2026. Scheduled departure 09:15. Actual departure 16:20. Cause: aircraft mechanical issue. Issued to passenger Brian O'Connell.
